title: Exact Product Support-Boundary Decomposition
starting_point: V1694.3 showed variation-current improves product identity, but Q_A/source separation remains the blocker.
claim_boundary: Mathematical derivation only. No execution, no retained field-law validation.
core_problem: The product action variation must be decomposed so boundary stress Q_oplus and support current rho_var^oplus are disjoint, not overlapping approximations.

variation_decomposition.support_variation: δ_support I_oplus = δ_T I + δ_w I + δ_oplus_kernel I + δ_orientation I
variation_decomposition.exact_identity_form: D_GammaR_Gamma^oplus = Q_A^oplus + rho_support^oplus only if rho_support is orthogonal/disjoint from boundary_A under declared decomposition.

support_current.definition: rho_support^oplus = δ_T I + δ_w I + δ_kernel I + δ_orientation I
support_current.lives_in: V_oplus* after mapping support variations back to retained-pair dual covectors

components.delta_T: pair birth/death or replacement current; must be represented by signed pair-incidence cochain
components.delta_kernel: native product kernel variation δ⊕ induces covector -2w_a <δ_a, T_A(δ⊕_p) - δ⊕_q(...)>
components.delta_orientation: Π-driven sign/orientation changes of retained pair incidence

support_current.orthogonality_rule: rho_support may not include Grad_A I_oplus terms; Q_A may not include support variations.

audits_required: boundary_support_disjointness: Q_A terms only from A-variation
support_current_disjointness: rho terms only from T,w,kernel,orientation variation
overlap_norm: inner product <Q_A, rho_support> reported but not optimized
zero_support_gate: if δ_support terms vanish, rho_support must be zero
zero_boundary_gate: if ∂C empty or boundary gradients vanish, Q_A must be zero

nulls.N_Q_support_contamination: put support variation terms into Q_A; must fail disjointness gate.
nulls.N_rho_boundary_contamination: put boundary gradient terms into rho; must fail disjointness gate.
nulls.N_weight_label_only: replace δw-derived current with label-only weight current; must fail.
nulls.N_pair_birth_unsigned: drop signed pair-incidence orientation; must fail support-current gate.
nulls.N_source_free_false: declare source-free when δ_support norms are nonzero; must fail zero-support gate.
